d: The Indian special forces have been known to carry out very difficult missions both within India and abroad. Very recently, the Indian marine commandos helped rescue a Maltan ship from hijackers in the Indian Ocean. This amazing rescue even garnered worldwide praise for Indian special forces... but who exactly are the special forces? What do they do? How do they train? In this video, we delve into the history of the formation of special forces and their present status. We also talk about what goes into becoming a special forces member and why it is not everyone's cup of tea.
